entries.what: Monday night shift on 4 West ran 1:7 with two call-outs; Thao and Jasmine split the sickest patients and Maribel stayed late on the floor. Around 5 a.m. Thao drafted a calm incident summary for Maribel.
entries.outcome: Incident summary written without complaints, and she decided she is voting yes.

entries.what: Got home to unit 207 as Tomás left for work, ate rice and eggs, and slept 8:30 to 3 behind the blackout curtains and box fan.
entries.outcome: Slept through one of Hạnh's 1 p.m. voicemails.

entries.what: Passed Judith in the hallway carrying a tote bag into 209, the first day she is staying weekdays with Elliot and Theo.
entries.outcome: Exchanged a quick hello and went back to packing her shift bag.

entries.what: Tuesday night shift: a quiet start, then the ratio improved with a float aide. Rubén's sheet saved time on charting.
entries.outcome: Got through the night without incident.

entries.what: Morning sleep, then an afternoon grocery run to Ruiz Family Market for fish sauce and produce.
entries.outcome: Stocked the fridge, including Tomás's shelf.

entries.what: Walked the Ulloa marsh boardwalk loop before leaving for work, then took the nurse shuttle from the gravel lot.
entries.outcome: A little calm before the shift.

entries.what: Day off. Slept in, did laundry with the card-only machines and reloaded $20.
Texted Jasmine about the next day's vote and Terrence's reminder flyer.
entries.outcome: Confirmed she will vote at the hospital after sleeping.

entries.what: Evening at home; Tomás made a giant pot of chili and left the pot soaking.
entries.outcome: She ate two bowls and let the pot go until morning.

entries.what: Went to St. Anselm in the afternoon and voted yes in the nurses union election, past Maribel and Terrence handing out stickers.
Stopped by Phở Bến Thành with Jasmine to trade vote talk and a shift swap request.
Early evening quiet at home with earplugs in against noise through the wall from 209.
Friday night shift on 4 West, with union talk in the break room and the homecoming game traffic noise outside.
entries.outcome: Steadier staffing and a calm night.

entries.what: Home at 8, slept until mid-afternoon, then texted Linh a quick check-in about midterms wrapping up.
Evening brushing teeth and packing a thermos of cà phê sữa đá for the next shift.
After a night of voicemails piling up with Hạnh's messages in Vietnamese, Thao asked the assistant for a greeting saying please text me, I work nights, and turned voicemail off.
entries.outcome: Voicemail replaced with a text me greeting.

entries.what: Slept the afternoon, then replied to Terrence with a thumbs-up text.
Evening cooking rice and packing leftovers for the shift.
Sunday sleep-in after the night, then watered pothos and the struggling basil on the balcony.
Texted Hạnh about Sunday dinner instead of calling.
Ate a late dinner with Tomás and rewatched the baking show to fall asleep.
